Gideon, I posted the answer in the #inc-vtg-hartford thread:

- **First report:** your 10:42 AM message on 3 Aug, which said the gate kiosks were offline and both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- **The guard in the meantime:** writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Six trucks were waiting at the east gate by 10:44.
- **Recovery:** kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

Caveat: support ticket SUP-5380 has an earlier log entry at 08:12 ("Rebot failed; drivers queueing"). I can't see who opened it, so check that before you treat 10:42 as the first report.
